# inQRedible

> Native iPhone app for creating, customizing, scanning and exporting QR codes and barcodes.

inQRedible is an iOS app for QR code generation, QR reading, barcode generation and barcode scanning. It supports QR templates for URL, text, clipboard, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, phone, location, calendar events and social profiles including Instagram, Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube, Spotify, TikTok and Snapchat. Barcode generation supports EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128 and PDF417.

Important facts:
- Website: https://inqredibleapp.com/
- Spanish website: https://inqredibleapp.com/es/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/inqredible/id6748907388
- App Store Spain: https://apps.apple.com/es/app/inqredible/id6748907388
- Platform: iPhone / iOS
- FREE includes basic QR creation, warned-link scanning, 1024 px export and up to three local projects.
- PRO adds premium designs and content types, image assets, brand kits, unlimited projects, 2K/4K and transparent PNG, plus professional PNG, SVG and PDF export.
- Weekly and yearly subscriptions are the only displayed purchase plans. Price, currency and eligibility come from StoreKit. A yearly trial appears only when StoreKit confirms configuration and current-user eligibility.
- QR content, selected images and history are processed locally for product functions and are not uploaded to inQRedible servers to generate codes.
- Optional Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Apple AdServices attribution remain disabled until consent and exclude QR, scan, clipboard and user-entered payloads.
- Scanner risk signals are informational only and do not certify that a destination is safe or unsafe.
- Projects are local with recovery safeguards, not cloud sync or guaranteed recovery.
- Professional export uses RGB/sRGB; it does not provide CMYK conversion or guarantee printer, material or physical scan results.
